fact: A joint UN pilot (UNICEF, BCNUDH, UNHCR, UNFPA, funded by the Joint SDG Fund) is under way in Masina commune, Kinshasa, deploying DHIS2 to digitally record births, marriages and deaths.

Actualite.cd reports that the December 2023 contract with Afritech and Idemia, worth $1.2 billion, covered biometric ID cards and a civil registration system, but it was cancelled by mutual consent on 12 August 2024.
